boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Endicott College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food runs around Beverly, Salem, and Danvers with late availability verified on current official pages. Confirm hours before leaving campus, especially for seasonal kitchens.

cards.title: The All-Night Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: Tacos and customizable fast food in Salem
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest option on this board; check transportation before making the trip from Endicott after midnight.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Salem drive-thru for customizable tacos, burritos, quesadillas, and other fast-food orders.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists the 267 Highland Avenue restaurant in Salem and shows its drive-thru as open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Salem, MA — 267 Highland Ave
cards.access_notes: The drive-thru is listed as open 24 hours every day; the dine-in area has shorter hours, so verify the service mode before traveling.

cards.title: The Seasonal Late Menu
cards.subtitle: A compact seafood kitchen at Salem’s Artists’ Row
cards.notes: Go before 11 p.m. for the late menu, and choose another stop if anyone in the group has a severe shellfish allergy.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal Salem restaurant serving a reduced late-night menu after its regular kitchen winds down.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant’s official contact page says it operates seasonally from April 1 to January 15 and offers a late-night menu until 11 p.m. nightly.
cards.access_notes: Late-night menu is listed until 11 p.m. nightly during the April 1–January 15 season; regular kitchen hours end earlier and severe shellfish allergies cannot be accommodated.

cards.title: The One A.M. Dining Room
cards.subtitle: American comfort food on Essex Street
cards.notes: Check the kitchen’s current serving window before leaving Beverly; the published 1 a.m. closing time may outlast full-menu service.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Salem restaurant with a published closing time that extends well past most Beverly kitchens.
cards.evidence_claim: Village Tavern’s official website identifies its location as 168 Essex Street in Salem and lists daily hours of 11 a.m.–1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant lists 11 a.m.–1 a.m. hours every day; confirm that the desired menu remains available late in the evening.

cards.title: The Derby Street Weekend Run
cards.subtitle: Sandwiches and comfort food in Salem
cards.notes: Plan this for Saturday or Sunday when the posted closing time reaches 1 a.m., and call ahead to confirm how late food is served.
cards.short_summary: A Derby Street gastropub whose official schedule extends to 1 a.m. on weekend nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Mercy Tavern’s official website lists its address as 148 Derby Street, Salem, and hours until 1 a.m. on Saturday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Mercy Tavern — Food, Drinks, and Music in Salem, MA
cards.access_notes: Saturday and Sunday hours are listed as noon–1 a.m.; other days use variable closing times, so verify food availability directly.

cards.title: The Friday-and-Saturday Sandwich Stop
cards.subtitle: Northeast-style sandwiches on Washington Street
cards.notes: Save this run for Friday or Saturday, when the restaurant posts 1 a.m. closing; verify the kitchen cutoff before departing campus.
cards.short_summary: A Salem sandwich-focused restaurant with later published hours on Friday and Saturday evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Babe’s official website lists its address as 268 Washington Street in Salem and Friday–Saturday lunch-and-dinner hours of 11 a.m.–1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant lists 11 a.m.–1 a.m. hours Friday and Saturday and 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday through Thursday; confirm late kitchen service.

cards.title: The Eleven P.M. Dinner
cards.subtitle: A sit-down Italian option in Danvers
cards.notes: Reserve enough travel and dining time for a Saturday visit; this is a full-service dinner run rather than a quick counter stop.
cards.short_summary: A Danvers Italian steakhouse whose Saturday dinner service is posted through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: I Pazzi’s official website lists its location as 51 High Street in Danvers and Saturday hours of 5–11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Saturday hours are listed as 5–11 p.m.; Tuesday through Friday close at 10 p.m., and Sunday dinner closes at 8 p.m.

cards.title: The Ten P.M. Cabot Street Pickup
cards.subtitle: Pizza, wraps, burritos, and quesadillas in Beverly
cards.notes: Order before the posted 10 p.m. close and allow time for preparation; this keeps the run inside Beverly rather than crossing to Salem.
cards.short_summary: A Beverly counter-service option combining pizza-shop staples with Spanish and Latin American dishes.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant’s direct ordering website identifies the business at 133 Cabot Street in Beverly and displays hours of 9 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Cabot Pizza & Spanish Food — Beverly, MA
cards.access_notes: The website currently displays a 10 p.m. closing time; submit pickup or delivery orders early enough for preparation before close.

cards.title: The Eleven P.M. Sandwich Run
cards.subtitle: Made-to-order sandwiches near Salem State
cards.notes: Use the Canal Street shop rather than the earlier-closing Beverly location, and verify the day’s hours before making the drive.
cards.short_summary: A Salem sandwich counter with an official schedule extending to 11 p.m. throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway’s official locator identifies the 119–125 Canal Street location in Salem and lists it as open from 9 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Subway at 119–125 Canal Street, Salem, MA
cards.access_notes: Official locator hours are 9 a.m.–11 p.m. daily; check the location page again before traveling because franchise hours can change.

cards.title: The Ten P.M. Waterfront Dinner
cards.subtitle: Family-operated Italian-American dining in Danvers
cards.notes: Go Wednesday through Saturday for the posted 10 p.m. close, and leave enough time for table service before the kitchen winds down.
cards.short_summary: A family-operated Danvers restaurant offering a later sit-down meal on four nights each week.
cards.evidence_claim: Sam & Joe’s official visit page lists the restaurant at 30 Water Street in Danvers and winter hours until 10 p.m. Wednesday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Winter hours are listed as 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Wednesday through Saturday; Tuesday and Sunday are closed, and seasonal schedules may differ.

cards.title: The Nine P.M. Beverly Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Pizza, breadsticks, and calzones on Cabot Street
cards.notes: Place the order before 9 p.m.; Endicott delivery is advertised with a minimum purchase and restrictions, so review the terms first.
cards.short_summary: A Beverly pizza shop with a direct Endicott connection through its stated campus-delivery offer.
cards.evidence_claim: Little Italy’s official website lists daily hours of 11 a.m.–9 p.m. at 294 Cabot Street and advertises delivery for Endicott students subject to restrictions.
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 9 p.m.; the advertised Endicott-student delivery offer requires an order over $20 and carries additional restrictions.

warnings: Late closing does not guarantee that every menu item, dining room, delivery service, or kitchen remains available until the posted business close; verify before travel.
The Lobster Shanty is seasonal, and Sam & Joe’s publishes a winter schedule.
Coordinates and maps URLs are null because they were not independently verified from authoritative map records during this pass.
